{
  "status": "encoded",
  "mapping": {
    "a": [
      "Exactly two slips exist for loan Lark.",
      "One slip records the issue.",
      "One slip records the return.",
      "No slip records both issue and return."
    ],
    "b": [
      "Loan Lark has two return slips on file.",
      "Both return slips count toward the total slips the library keeps for loan Lark."
    ]
  },
  "smt2": "(set-logic AUFLIA)

;; Declare a sort for slips
(declare-sort Slip 0)

;; Declare a constant for the loan Lark
(declare-const Lark String)

;; Predicate: slipForLoan(slip, loan)
(declare-fun slipForLoan (Slip String) Bool)

;; Predicate: recordsIssue(slip)
(declare-fun recordsIssue (Slip) Bool)

;; Predicate: recordsReturn(slip)
(declare-fun recordsReturn (Slip) Bool)

;; Define two distinct slips s1 and s2 for loan Lark
(declare-const s1 Slip)
(declare-const s2 Slip)

;; Assert s1 and s2 are distinct slips
(assert (not (= s1 s2)))

;; Both slips are for loan Lark
(assert (slipForLoan s1 "Lark"))
(assert (slipForLoan s2 "Lark"))

;; No other slips for loan Lark exist
;; (forall (s Slip) (=> (slipForLoan s "Lark") (or (= s s1) (= s s2))))
(assert (forall ((s Slip)) (=> (slipForLoan s "Lark") (or (= s s1) (= s s2)))))

;; Exactly two slips for loan Lark (from above)

;; One slip records the issue
(assert (or (recordsIssue s1) (recordsIssue s2)))
;; One slip records the return
(assert (or (recordsReturn s1) (recordsReturn s2)))

;; Neither slip records both issue and return
(assert (not (and (recordsIssue s1) (recordsReturn s1))))
(assert (not (and (recordsIssue s2) (recordsReturn s2))))

;; From b: Loan Lark has two return slips on file
;; So both s1 and s2 record return slips
(assert (recordsReturn s1))
(assert (recordsReturn s2))

;; Both return slips count toward the number of slips the library keeps for that loan
;; This is already modeled by slipForLoan predicate and the two slips s1 and s2

",
  "note": "The encoding faithfully represents the English statements treating 'slips' as distinct entities for loan Lark. Statement a requires exactly two slips: one for issue and one for return, with no slip serving both. Statement b asserts that loan Lark has two return slips on file, both counting toward the total slips. This conflicts with a's exclusivity condition, as a slip cannot record both issue and return, yet b requires two return slips, implying both slips record return. The encoding captures this contradiction by asserting both slips record return (from b) while a forbids any slip recording both issue and return. The domain is limited to slips for loan Lark, and all other slips are assumed not to exist for that loan."
}
